title: Move old proof into the knowledge vault: trim loose artifacts of cold changes and move key items into knowledge attachments (KNOW-18, KNOW-19)
description: Move old proof into the knowledge vault: trim loose artifacts of cold changes and move key items into knowledge attachments (KNOW-18, KNOW-19)
acceptance_criteria: Loose artifact entries no record references are trimmed and ledgered as loose artifacts once the change that listed or made them is cold, and listed in its knowledge note; entries of current work, named by the checkpoint or an open bug, or listed by a hot archive stay; a closed bug releases its fixture. Key items of a cold change (manual or agent-assisted observations whose only protection is being non-routine, failed-run logs, screenshots and failure-first logs) move to knowledge/attachments/<archive>/, mapped in the ledger and linked from the note. New tests fail first, the trim on this repository is measured, and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Leif (0xLeif) chose Loose artifact folders (KNOW-18) and Key items move (KNOW-19), confirmed KNOW-16 to KNOW-19 (Yes, build it), and on 2026-11-04 asked that artifacts and evidence actually be transitioned into the knowledge vault. Ledger first, the KNOW-10 restore check, no removal while a change is open, and bytes in Git stay.
